static_traits.name: Li Na
static_traits.marital_status: In a relationship with the boss
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to confide in, but not yet discussing work-related issues with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy; no similar problems before

basic_info.main_problem: After losing a house sale at work today, I feel I am untrustworthy to my boss, which makes me very anxious and nervous.
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts and feelings are affecting my work performance and causing significant distress; I hope to prove I am trustworthy to my boss and reduce anxiety.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being trusted

special_situations.event: Lost a house sale at work (that day's viewing and negotiation failed, the client withdrew at the negotiation stage)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not close deals, it means I am untrustworthy and incompetent, and will be negated by my boss
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly self-rationalizing; seeking comfort and reassurance from the boss
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure proves I am untrustworthy; I will keep disappointing my boss

special_situations.event: After the incident the boss acted somewhat distant, although he had tried to comfort me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he is not as close or warm as usual, it means he is disappointed in me and finds me untrustworthy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Being overly cautious, repeatedly guessing his views, self-doubting about everything
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must feel I disappointed him; he no longer trusts me

special_situations.event: Recalls a client withdrawing during the negotiation stage, causing the deal to fail
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A client's withdrawal shows my ability is inadequate, which will trigger career crisis and relationship breakdown
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive worry and insomnia; trying to alleviate anxiety through self-persuasion
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure will ruin my work and relationships

special_situations.event: Constantly worries about the boss's evaluation of her credibility
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: My worth and credibility depend on my boss's approval
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly seeking comfort and recognition from the boss to confirm self-worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Only if my boss recognizes me am I worthy of trust

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and trusted by significant others (boss/partner), maintaining an intimate and stable relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, rejected, and losing the relationship, while worrying about career prospects being damaged
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being negated through rationalization and excessive self-monitoring
Working hard to gain external recognition to maintain a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: Feeling after failure that one is an 'untrustworthy, incompetent' subordinate/partner
object_relations.object_representation: A distant and possibly disappointed authority figure/partner

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing work failure or thinking about the boss's view of them
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe the boss will negate oneself over one mistake; both relationship and career in danger (with projection/mind-reading tendencies)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Mainly gives explanations and reasons; tone is calm but avoids going into emotions; emphasizes external factors to reduce self-blame, avoiding facing inner shame and fear.

manifestations: Relationship with the boss strained by the incident, and he seems distant
Feeling embarrassed toward friends and not yet seeking support; maintaining silence and self-isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Concluding the boss 'finds me untrustworthy / is disappointed in me' without evidence
Projecting inner unease and shame onto others' evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Cautious in everything, repeatedly self-doubting, worrying any move will be negatively evaluated by the boss
Persistent tension and excessive concern about others' opinions lead to impaired work performance

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Taking 'I must prove myself trustworthy' as a self-demand
Directly internalizing the boss's expectations as the standard for judging self-worth

positive_force: Shown as reliable and good at closing deals in past work (resource foundation)
Willing to communicate openly (plans to talk frankly with the boss)
Having some self-reflection and motivation to improve
Having a certain social support network (a few friends to communicate with)
negative_force: Over-reliance on external recognition to judge self-worth (external validation)
Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mind reading and other maladaptive cognitive patterns reinforcing anxiety
Insomnia and persistent worry weakening work focus and performance
Blurred boundaries between work and intimate relationship causing stress to focus on a single other's evaluation

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and excessive worry about whether the boss trusts oneself
antecedent: Recalling the failure situation after losing a house sale that day
The boss showing distance or not being as close as before
Thinking of future work performance and the boss's evaluation
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing cognition about failure, and taking the boss's recognition as the main source of self-worth (external validation)
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncertainty and potential criticism; trying to gain control and security through worry and self-monitoring
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance; sleep impaired; relationship tension with the boss; daily life interrupted by persistent anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids discussing work-related troubles with friends
antecedent: Worrying others are unable to understand and evaluate oneself
target_behavior.core_reason: Choosing to stay silent to avoid exposing vulnerability and encountering negation, short-term relieving discomfort
target_behavior.function: Escaping the risk of possible negative evaluation or not being understood
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient use of social support; intensified sense of isolation; anxiety maintained and aggravated
